name: @mouthpeace/buddy-stats
description: Local observability dashboard for harness AI usage statistics

scripts.check: biome check src scripts test build.ts tailwind.config.js tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.client.json tsconfig.publish.json package.json && bun run check:types
scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts test build.ts tailwind.config.js
scripts.fix: biome check --write --unsafe src scripts test build.ts tailwind.config.js tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.client.json tsconfig.publish.json package.json
scripts.fmt: biome format --write src scripts test build.ts tailwind.config.js tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.client.json tsconfig.publish.json package.json
